eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Lassen, CA; at 3:43 PM on AUG 15, 2021 Effective until 3:43 PM AUG 16, 2021. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
NEW DIXIE FIRE EVACUATION WARNING 3:00PM
The emergency alert zone map can be accessed at:  community.zonehaven.com

Due to anticipated winds, a New Evacuation Warning has been issued for: 
West of Hwy 395 from Janesville Grade south to the Stuart Ln. intersection and west to the Lassen County line. 

All previously issued evacuation orders and warnings remain in place.

Those under warning who require assistance and those with pets and livestock should leave now.  Use caution, drive with your headlights on and yield to emergency personnel. If you need assistance evacuating, call 530-257-6121. An Emergency Shelter is located at Lassen Community College in Susanville.  The Shelter number is (530) 250-9004.  Large animals can be taken to Lassen County Fairgrounds.  Deputies will be going door to door to make notifications.
